en.text:
Cold moss under your paws. The same grey light through the same leaves, and the same three notes of a bird you cannot name. Above you, the crow shifts her weight on the high branch, a wedge of cheese held in her beak, and looks past you toward the thorn bush at the edge of the clearing.

You are hungry. The day has only just begun, and it feels as though it has begun before.

zh.text:
湿冷的苔藓贴着你的爪子。同样的灰光穿过同样的树叶，同样三声你叫不出名字的鸟鸣。头顶高枝上，乌鸦换了换爪，嘴里衔着一角奶酪，目光越过你，落向林间空地边缘那丛荆棘。

你饿了。这一天刚刚开始，却像是已经开始过。
